description: IEEE Xplore search targets for venue-profile calibration. Papers feed calibration/PAPERS.md → literature/<slug>/ → analyze → profile updates.

year_window.comment: Set years_back to 3 in scripts via CALIBRATION_YEARS_BACK=3

targets.label: IEEE TCAD (journal)
targets.publication_title: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems
targets.query: ("design automation" OR "computer-aided design" OR EDA OR "analog design")
targets.notes: Prefer methodology-heavy CAD papers; skip pure survey unless high citation.

targets.label: IEEE TCAS-I (journal)
targets.publication_title: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers
targets.query: ("analog" OR "mixed-signal" OR LDO OR amplifier OR "data converter")
targets.notes: Circuit-first papers; compare section titles and measurement figures vs TCAD.

targets.label: IEEE CAD conference papers (short)
targets.query: ("computer-aided design" OR "design automation" OR ICCAD OR ISPD OR DATE) AND (conference OR proceedings)

venue_contains_any: International Symposium on Circuits and Systems

targets.notes: Post-filter keeps IEEE-relevant CAD conference proceedings; manually drop non-IEEE venues after search.
